claim: The sample demo is populated, resettable, and does not read or change real saved settings.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; seed real IndexedDB and localStorage, use and reset /?demo=1, compare byte-for-byte snapshots.

claim: Photo, filename, and Google JSON data stay on the device during repair and export.
where: First screen, privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh browser context on /?demo=1; capture the complete demo flow and assert every request is same-origin.

claim: The repaired export adds the Google date and location to JPEG photos.
where: Support note, how it works, terms, README
sandbox: Export /demo; parse the JPEG EXIF and assert the exact sample date and a GPS directory.

claim: The repaired export adds the Google date and location to PNG photos.
where: Support note, how it works, terms, README
sandbox: Export /demo; parse the PNG eXIf chunk and assert the exact sample date and a GPS directory.

claim: The repaired export skips files with identical bytes when exact-copy removal is selected.
where: First screen, figure, how it works, README
sandbox: Export /demo with its album copy; assert exactly one skipped-duplicate result in the export log.

claim: The repaired export renames matched files by their restored dates.
where: First screen, how it works, README
sandbox: Export /demo; assert JPEG and PNG paths begin with their exact restored UTC dates.

claim: HEIC, HEIF, and video files are copied without metadata changes.
sandbox: Export /demo; assert copy-only statuses and byte equality for the sample HEIC, HEIF, and MP4.

claim: Photo payload bytes are retained when metadata is added.
where: Support note, how it works, README
sandbox: Export /demo; assert original JPEG payload markers and the original PNG IEND chunk remain intact.

claim: Every repaired export contains a JSON log entry for each input media file.
where: Export panel, how it works, README
sandbox: Export /demo to ZIP and a stubbed folder; parse each takeout-tidy-manifest.json and assert seven decisions for seven sample media files.

claim: The repaired files and export log can be written to a selected folder.
sandbox: Start at /demo; stub a writable directory, export, and assert each repaired file plus the seven-entry JSON log is written.

claim: The matcher handles standard Google JSON names, shortened names, and duplicate album filenames.
sandbox: Open /demo; assert standard supplemental, shortened, and (1) album-copy Google JSON files are paired with the intended media.

claim: The demo can reload, repair, and export offline after the first load.
sandbox: Fresh browser context on /demo; wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and download the repaired ZIP.

claim: Repair is free for up to 20,000 media files and gated above that count.
sandbox: Start at /demo, enter real mode, import generated ZIPs with 20,000 and 20,001 files, and assert the export boundary.

claim: The large-library unlock costs $12 once with no subscription.
sandbox: Fresh browser context from /demo to home; assert exact copy and the hosted Sociobot checkout URL.

claim: The app imports a selected folder, and requests permission only after the folder action.
sandbox: Start at /demo, enter real mode, stub a folder with a matched photo, assert timing, and reach the preview.

claim: The app imports one or more Google Photos Takeout ZIP files into one preview.
sandbox: Start at /demo, enter real mode, import two generated Takeout ZIP files, and assert both matched photos share one preview.

claim: Real-mode repair settings and the last export summary can be exported and imported as JSON.
sandbox: Start at /demo, enter real mode, change settings, complete an export, download settings JSON, clear site data, import it, and assert restoration.

claim: Real mode stores only repair settings, the last export summary, and an activated license result.
sandbox: Start at /demo, enter real mode, change settings and export; enumerate localStorage and IndexedDB and assert only documented stores and keys.

claim: Development and builds require Node.js 20 or newer.
sandbox: Read package.json in the clean checkout and assert the Node engines floor is 20.

claim: The production build creates dist/index.html plus the PWA, metadata, and static-host files.
sandbox: Run through the production Playwright web server build, then assert each documented artifact exists under dist/.

claim: The static-host build applies the documented security and cache rules.
sandbox: Parse dist/staticwebapp.config.json and assert CSP, frame, permissions, MIME, service-worker, manifest, and immutable hashed-asset policies.

claim: Purchases and license checks use Sociobot endpoints without a payment-provider SDK.
sandbox: Build the app; assert the buy and verify origins are Sociobot and scan source and bundles for direct payment-provider SDKs.
